segments.text: The session is called to order. The secretary will call the roll.
All ten members are present. There is a quorum.
First on the agenda is the supplemental Annual Investment Program for the health office.
The health office asks for two more barangay health stations and medicine for six months.
Buy one take one at the public market this weekend only.
The committee on appropriations recommends approval of Proposed Ordinance 2027-001.
A member asks where the money comes from. The budget officer answers: savings in Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses.
Next is a resolution asking the engineering office to report on the drainage project by March.
The resolution is approved without objection.
There being no other business, the session is adjourned.
